description: PaperDock helps researchers work on private LaTeX projects through ChatGPT. Users can create projects, find and edit source files, add or replace project files, and collaborate through Comments and Chat. Every action follows the user's current PaperDock project role, and source edits remain inspectable through Review changes.

defaultPrompt: Create a project named "My Paper", then list my projects.
In “My Paper”, read the comments, post helpful replies, then revise main.tex to address the feedback.
In “My Paper”, upload “Your Local File”, use it as Figure 2, and clarify Results without changing its meaning.
